reading.title: My Grandfather
reading.text: My grandfather has a long grey beard and a thick moustache. He grew the beard ten years ago. Every morning he brushes his hair and combs his beard in front of the mirror. When I was little, I tried to cut his moustache with scissors, and Mum was very angry! Last summer he shaved off his beard, and we did not know him. Now he is growing it again.

reading.text: Yesterday I was at the bus station when I saw a familiar face. It was my old teacher! She has a round, friendly face and always has a smile on it. Then she looked at his back. At the end my brother was happy again and had a big smile on his face. We bought a face mask for him at the pharmacy.

reading.text: Last week I had a toothache, so Mum took me to the dentist. I have a sweet tooth, and I eat too many sweets. The dentist asked me to open my mouth wide. She said I had a bad tooth and had to fill it. It did not hurt much. Now I brush my teeth after every meal, and I try to eat fewer sweets.

reading.title: A Sore Throat
reading.text: On Monday I had a sore throat and could not speak well. Mum looked at my throat and said, "Stick out your tongue." It was red. She gave me warm tea with honey. Before bed she kissed me goodnight on the cheek and smiled at me. "You will feel better soon," she said. The next day my throat was fine and I went to school with a big smile.

The doctor said I must not carry heavy bags. He told me to wear a warm scarf round my neck. I shrugged my shoulders and smiled. Now I use a backpack with two straps.
